_comment: JEXI MCP server registry (AGI Phase 2). Every server is DISABLED by default — Lewis enables what he trusts. permissions are the server's granted boundary: READ_ONLY, LOCAL_WRITE, NETWORK, EXECUTION, GIT, DEPLOYMENT, DESTRUCTIVE. trustLevel: curated (reviewed for JEXI) | community (reviewed upstream only).

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Official MCP reference server — bounded file access with allowlisted roots (read and write within roots only).
servers.notes: Roots must be set to the JEXI workspace, never the home directory.

servers.name: git
servers.description: Official MCP reference server — repository operations (status, diff, log, commit) through a standard, audited interface.
servers.notes: No push/force-push: destructive git operations stay with JEXI's own authorized GitHub path.

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: Official MCP reference server — URL to markdown fetching with size and timeout limits.
servers.notes: Complements JEXI's native deep-read; useful for simple structured fetches.

servers.name: sqlite
servers.description: Official MCP reference server — read-mostly SQL queries over SQLite databases.
servers.notes: JEXI data lives in JSON; SQL analysis is a genuine capability gap this fills safely.

servers.name: memory
servers.description: Official MCP reference server — knowledge-graph memory (entities and relations). Studied as a cross-check on JEXI's own memory design.
servers.notes: Optional; JEXI's own WorldModel + memory layers remain the primary memory.

servers.name: playwright
servers.description: Community Playwright MCP server — browser automation through the MCP standard. Only enable if it adds beyond JEXI's native browser control.
servers.notes: Evaluated, not defaulted on — JEXI's native browser path is already proven.
